steps.body: After the teens comes **twenty**! … 17, 18, 19, **20**. Keep hopping — the line goes on.

widget.prompt: Start at 9. Hop forward 3 times. Where do you land?

commonLandings.feedback: That is two hops. One more lands on 12.
That is four hops. Three hops from 9 is 12.

predict.prompt: Starting at 9 and hopping forward 3 times — bigger number or smaller number?
predict.reveal: No matter how many forward hops you take from 9, you finish on a bigger number — landing smaller than 9 would take hopping backward, and every hop here goes forward.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents count to 20.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for count to 20 must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines count to 20.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

Hop by ones to travel between any two numbers.
